resumen: Reserva: lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00, Dr. Jordi Vilar, Arenal Norte

eventos.texto: Good morning, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hello, I'd like dermatology with Dra. Iglesias, please.
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Ficha encontrada: Carmen L. (por DNI y nombre)
Sin huecos en dermatología · frenados por regla: Dra. Carmen Iglesias (ese médico no trabaja con su seguro)
El médico pedido está de baja: busca con otro (376 huecos)
Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00 con el Dr. Jordi Vilar en Arenal Norte

Thank you, Carmen, I have your record here. Dra. Carmen Iglesias doesn't take your insurance. The earliest with another dermatology at Arenal Norte is Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Jordi Vilar. Would you like that instead?
Reserva · lunes 21 de septiembre, 8:00 · Dr. Jordi Vilar · Arenal Norte
That's booked: Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Jordi Vilar at Arenal Norte. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
